name: Moero Downhill Night Blaze
source:
The Downhill Night saga concludes with this explosive final chapter, bringing everyone from the second game back together: our hero Akito, the sexy and willing Rinka, the rich Reiko, the sweet and charming race queen, Tomomi, and the mysteriously attractive Kei. New racing tracks face Akito who is locked in a dangerous love triangle that can only be resolved by winning the Touge Grand Touring Car Championship. As he gets behind the wheel to win, who's heart will he win and who's will he break? There can only be one champion on these hot tracks of heated love.

[From [url=https://jastusa.com/games/p018/]JAST USA[/url]]
translation:
《Downhill Night》系列以这部火爆的最终章落幕，第二作所有角色再次齐聚：主人公秋人、性感主动的凛香、富家女玲子、甜美迷人的赛车女郎友美，以及神秘而富有魅力的圭。秋人面临全新赛道，也陷入一场危险的三角恋，唯有赢得山道房车锦标赛才能解决。坐上驾驶席争夺胜利时，他会赢得谁的心，又会伤害谁？在这些爱情炽热的赛道上，冠军只能有一个。

[摘自[url=https://jastusa.com/games/p018/]JAST USA[/url]]
